newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux in telecoms linkup. [CORRECTED 12:12 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux in telecoms linkup. [CORRECTED 12:12 GMT]

text.p: Cie Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier announced on Thursday its main strategic partners in its Cegetel telecommunications unit would be British Telecommunications Plc, U.S. telecommunications company SBC and Mannesmann of Germany.
Water and services giant Generale des Eaux will hold 50 percent of Cegetel directly and indirectly, SBC 15 percent and Mannesmann 10 percent.
Messier also said on Thursday its Cagetel communications unit would have seven billion francs of "free cash" to invest as of January 1, 1997.

(Corrects by removing erroneous reference to Alcatel selling stake in Generale des Eaux's mobile telephones unit Cofira for seven billion francs and makes clear that seven billion francs refers to the sum Cegetel will have to invest).
Earlier on Thursday, Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk announced that the company had agreed to sell its 25 percent stake in Cofira to British Telecom.
